A '''repulsor mine''' or '''repulsor-trip mine'''<ref name="RB">{{JournalCite|9|Repulsortank Battlefield}}</ref> was a type of [[Mine/Legends|mine]]. The [[Tiaran'grast Sling Course]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] challenged its competitors with repulsor mine obstacles, which caused ionization damage to one's [[sling racer]].
